summary: Fixed GPU engine PnL timing by deferring PnL credit to position release (close) time instead of entry (open) time.
design_decisions: Added slot_pnl array to JAX scan carry to store net PnL per open position slot
Sortino statistics are computed at entry time (not release) because trade_ret = net_pnl / equity requires entry-time equity, matching CPU engine behavior
Final release after scan credits remaining open positions' PnL to equity and counts wins/losses

tests_run.command: PYTEST_LOW_MEMORY=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/test_gpu_engine.py tests/unit/test_gpu_engine_jax_failure.py tests/unit/test_numba_ops.py tests/unit/test_encoder.py -x -q

gpu_vs_cpu_parity.description: 10 random chromosomes, binary + signed features, 120-row multi-symbol dataset

notes_for_reviewer: Sortino stats remain at entry time (not moved to release) because trade_ret = net_pnl / equity requires entry-time equity context — this matches the CPU engine's _simulate_rule_set_entries which also appends trade_return at entry
The fix changes equity dynamics significantly: with sequential sampling, previously an all-positive dataset would show 953% max_return; now it should show reasonable returns matching CPU
Pre-existing test failure in tests/unit/test_phase2_rule_pool.py::TestRobustReturnObjective::test_f3_uses_min_train_val_return is unrelated to this change
